title: A finite acyclic resolution computes a right derived functor
statement: Let $v:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ be a left exact additive functor [def-sp-left-exact-additive] between abelian categories [def-sp-abelian] with enough injectives [def-sp-injective-resolutions], and let $M$ be an object of $\mathcal A$. Suppose there is an exact augmented complex $0\to M\to C^0\to\cdots\to C^n\to0$ such that every $C^i$ is $v$-acyclic (that is, $R^qv(C^i)=0$ for all $q>0$). Then the cohomology of the complex $0\to v(C^0)\to\cdots\to v(C^n)\to0$ is canonically isomorphic to $R^qv(M)$ in every degree $q$.
